comment_regular: Looks up Script_CommandList[functionIndex]. If paramIndex exists and its ParamInfo type is ObjectReferenceID (4) or Actor (6), a missing condition param1 may fall back to the current resolved/swapped target. Other types (Quest, Global, Class, Race, Sex, etc.) do not use this target fallback.
